ma mchis pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa mkha' yi rgyu skar dang / sa yi mishing lta bur bgrang gis mi lang ba rim par byon cing / de dag gis thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum sogs sku gsung zugs gsum gyi mdzad bzang bla na med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang bas lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzam gling nor 'dzin gyi khyon kun tu khyab par spel ba lags la/de dag las rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa pho byi ba pyi lo 1648lor mtshan dpe me rtog gangs can sā la'i sman ldongs su bzhad cing / lde snod gsum dang / sgra tshad sdeb bh+yor snyan dngags mngon brjod la sogs pa'i shun mong dang can mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la 'chad rtsod rtsom par 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral bas 'phags yul paṇa chen dag gi zla 'or gyur pa yul gangs can pa'i gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen yo/ lam gyi gtso so rin so che rnam pa gsum gyis ni shugs rgyud legs par lcag yi dam gyi lha du mas ni rjes su bzungaka zab lam rdo rje zeg pa'i rim gnyis skya lam nas grub pa'i go 'phang ma'on khor gshegs pa'i chos kyi rje kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gzhan phan dbang po'i sde zhes grags snyan gyi ba dan dkar 4 srid pa gsum na ches cher g.yo ba de nyid kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho'i 'jing lta bu rnams las gtso bor gyur pa ni/ zhing 'dir mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i rnam par byon te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che sgyi dang / lhag par 'jam mgon chos skya rgyal po tsong kha pa chen gas lung rigs dri ma med pas dag zer legs par mdzad cing] thos bsam sgom gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i bzhed srol zun mong ma yin pa/ ltaspyod gcig grogs gcig tu song zhingadapyad 'jog zung du 'gril ba'i sgom tshul khyad par du 'phags pa/zos bsam phyogs rer ma song zhing sgom sgrub kyi nyams myong tshad mar son pa/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu
sgrub yab sras kyi zun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed srol/ slob dpon bud+dha pā li ta dang / bdag nyid chen po zla ba grags pa'i zugs kyi bcud/ stong pa rten 'byung gi don dang / rten 'byung stong pa'i don du la(ga tshul gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa sogs khyad par 'phags chos 'bum gyis snyog pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi rim par 'gal ba med par legs par 'doms pa'i tshang la mnor ba'i lugs bzang/ rje btsun 'jam pa'idabyangs kyi zhal lung) lo gsum phyogs gsum tsam la'ang zung 'jug gi go 'phang bde blag tu nyer ba'i myur lam/dpal mnyam med ri 'o dge ldan ba'i mdo sngags zung 'tshel gyi bstan pa rin 4 che gser gyi yang zhun ltabu 'di nyid 'tshad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis spel bar mdzad pa 'de ga lags la/ dedag las kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mtshog bstan pa'i sgron mes/ zab rgyas chos kyi de nyid don/ /ji bzhin 'doms pa chesadakonalangaka /gabrul bral khyod gsung glegs bam rnams/ /gdung seladabugs dbyung mchog sbyin 'gyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar phyi rabs gdul bya'i thun mong gi bgo skal du gnang ba'i rtsom pa legs bshad kyi skyes bzang yo 'di dag ni skye dgu'i slongs pa sel ba'i sa gsum gyi sgron me nyid du bzhugs la/ sbyor kun mkhyen chen po'i legs bshad 'di dag ni rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'phags yul paṇa grub dag gi dgongs 'grel tshad mar gyur pa dag gi tshig dang don gyi dka' gnas mtha' dag bde blag tu 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bu yin pa ni gzu sor gnas pa'i mkhas pa dag la bsnyon med du grub la/ po hi lnga'i mtha'adaphyod ltabur mtshonanalang gdan sa gsum gyisag cha phal mo che'i sgyi rtsomayin gzhis/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i legs bshad mtha'adag gi barbad 'dus shing] tshig gi zhakhri ba phra mo tshun chadanas bdar sha chod cingad mdo dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos tshad thub 'od skad du 'gyur ro cog dpang khor bzhag ste gnad la 'drel ba'idabyad pa mthil phyin mdzad pa sha stag yin pas gron med legs bshad kyi phung ṭo 'ba' zhig yin pa ni gzur gnas rnam dpyod kyi mig dkyus yud tsam g.yos pas kyang mkhyen

sems bskyed dang po/bcom thob pa mi 'thad par thal/ rten 'brel bstan pa'i tshe de la rang gi 'dod bya ma rdzogs pa'i smo rang du ma snang bas so snyam na/ de'i lan du kha cig ces sogs byung bar 'dod de/ 'grel bshad las/ gal te rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yod zin kyang nyan thos la sogs pa'i go 'phang la las ma thob par snang bas phyin ci ma log pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bstan pas nyan thos la sogs pazungangs su rdzogs par 'argyur ba ci'i phyir brjod ce nade'i lan bstan pa'i phyigagal te kha cig gis zhes bya ba la thenags pa smos te/ zhes gsungs/ rnam bshad las/ kha cig rten 'brel bstan kyang / zhes pa nas/ 'dod pa dang zhes byung/ yang 'od kha cig na re/ rten 'brel gyi don nyams su blangs ma thag 'byung rigs pa lasade med pas phyis kyang 'bras bu mi skyed snyam pa'i lan du 'dodade/rnam bshad las/gzhan rten 'brel skye med kyidon nyams su blangs ma thag/nas/lan ston par bshad pa ni zhes byung/ de gnyis la/'o na/ skabs lanar gtso 4radogs pa gcod sa nyan rang gnyis ka yin par thal/ rtsod tshul dang lan 'thad pa'i phyig 'dod na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi gsung las bskyed ces pa de mi 'thad snyam pa'i dogs pa che bar thal/ 'dod pa'i pyid gdod mi nus te/ nyan thos kyi ming don las kyang dogs pa chung ba'i phyir dang/ gzungs rgyal gyis zhus pa las/ nyan thos rnams kyi rnam grol sgra sbyir 'gro/ /zhes pa ltar grub mtha' bzhi ka ladod pa'i phyir dang / mdo du mar yang don re re bstan pa'i tshe yang gang zag 'di snyed kyis 'bras bu bzhi sogs thob par bshad pa shin tu mang ba'i phyiradang]des na skabs don ma rtogs pa'i rtsod tshul dang lan yin par snang ba'i pyig rnam bshad las/ skabs don ma rtogs pa'i bshad ba lte/zhes gsungs pa'i phyidadesanade'idogs pa gcod sa'i gtso boni rang rgyaladangade'inanganas kyang rang rgyaladagra bcom pa layinate/ sbyor rang rgyal tshogs lam pa phal cher la sangs rgyas gabor du 'byung ba'ang mang la/ 'phags pa'ang tshogs sbyod pa gnyis ni 'gras 24
nyan rang thub dbang las skyes tshul/bu dang po gsum thob pa yin kyang sangs rgyas kyi dngor du byung] rang rgyal gsum sga'i yang srid pa tha ma'i tshe sangs rgyas dngadage ba'i bshes gnyen mi bsten pas nade sangs rgyas kyis bskrun pa mi 'thad snyam pa'idogs pa che ba'i migadang lo grub ste/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal rigasanges kyi tshogs lam pas bskal pa chen 4 brgyar sangs rgyas 'byung ba la tshogs bsags nas drod yan chad tshe gcig la mngon du byed/ tshogs spyod pa phal cher yang tshogs lam dus su sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes pa kho na yin pa'i pyir te/drin lan bsab pa'i mdo las/ rang sangs rgyas bskal pa chen po brgyas tshar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang /rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gzhan dag ni/ sangs rgyas mnyes byas nges 'byed kyi/ /cha mthun skyed pa rdzogs byed do/ /zhes tshogs rgyud pa kha cig gis sangs rgyas la bh+yor lam drod 6bzod pa'i bar du bsten nas 'bras bu mngon du mi bya bar bshad pade'i pyid 4rtags gnyis pa grub lte/rtog ge 'bar ba las/gzhan ni sangs rgyas 'byung la 'bras/ /thob byed dgra bcom mngon mi byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/sangs rgyas 'byung ba la brten nasadagra bcom pa gcig bu mngon du mi byed kyang 'bras budang 4 gsum thob par byed ces bshad pa'i phyig ②rtags gsum pa grub ste/de'i tshe mi bsten pa gang zhig/de'i rgyu mtshan gyisadogs pa che ba'i pyid dang 4 grub lte/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can gsum ka yang dang 4 nas nga rgyal can yin pas slob dpon med par 'tshang rgya bar smon lam btab pa bzhin/ srid pa tha ma'i tshe gzhan la ma brten par rang byung gi sgo nas rang gi byang chub mngon du byed par 'dra ba'i phyir te/rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gsum po de dag nyid dag gis/ /sangs rgyas med par dgra bcom nyid/ /slob dpon med par 'jub dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid des na 'di ni blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mkhas pa gang zhe na/ zhes sogs dang / sa bcu pa'i yang dgongs pa yin la/ sa'i dngos gzhi dang byang sa dang / legs 25
sems bskyed dang po/bshad gser phreng sogs kyi dgongs pa yin pas blun pos blos byas la ma zhen cig /'dis ni rang rgyal skye 'phags gnyis sangs rgyas lubor du mi 'ong snyam pa dang / rang rgyal la zhugs gnas med snyam pa dang gang zag ya brgyad med snyam pa'i log rtog gi bya brgya rigs pa'i 'ur rdo gcig gis bdas pa yin par shes par gyis/ rgyas par grub mtha'i rnam bshad du spros zin to/ /rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ de sangs rgyas kyis bskrun na de la gzhan la ma brten pas rang byung dang rang rgyal gyi don sngar bshad pa dang rkyen tsam gyis don khong du chud pas na rkyen rtogs zhes pa mi 'thad do snyam pa'i dogs pa che ba'i phyig khyab ste/ rnam bshad las/ de ltar na de la dogs pa che bas de ladamigs kyis bkar nas dogs pa gcod dgos pa la ma bcad 'dug pa'i pyidzhes gsungs pa'i phyidyang kha cig gis/ 'de'i dogs yul la stong nyid nyan tsam ma gtogs stong nyid ma rtogs pas khyab par thal/ bena'i gtso 'oradogs gcod byed pade sangs rgyas las chos thos pa'i tshe de la 'bras gnas lta ci/rten 'brel zab mo la bsam byung dang sgom byung tsam yang ma thob par skye ba phyi mdagra bcom thobanges kyi rang rgyal skye la5gas ladogs pa gcod payin pa'i phyigader thal/de ro'i rang rgyal dgra bcom des rgyal ba de'i thad du rten 'brel la sgom byung ma thob pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub lte/ rang 'grel las/ gal te yang kha cig gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba nye bar bstan pa nyan pa khon las don dam pa rtogs pa la mkhas su zin kyang zhes dang rnam bshad las/ gal te rang rgyal gyi rigs can kha cig ston pas rten 'grel gsung ba nyan pa kho na las don dam pa rtogs pa la mkhas pa byung yang / zhes gsungs pa'i mig khyab ste/ nyan pa kho na zhes pa gnyis kyi rnam bcad kyi don re yod pa'i phyig des na nyan pa kho na yin la rten 'brel stong nyid ma rtogs zer mi rung bar ma zad/ sangs rgyas las chos thos pa'i tshe de 26
nyan rang thub dbang las skyes tshul/la rang rgyal dgra bcom gyi go 'phang mngon du byas pa yang yod par gdod mi rung ste/ rang 'grel las/ mthong ba'i skye ba kho na la mya ngan las 'das pa thob par mi 'gyur mod kyi/ zhes dang / rnam bshad las/ mthong ba'i chos kyi skye ba kho na la rang rgyal gyi myang 'das mi thob yod kyang zhes pa dang / sngar rang rgyal gsum gyi 'bras bu 'grub tshul bshad zin pa de'i mig yang rang rgyal gyi rigs can sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa'i gang zag yin na'ang / srid pa tha ma'i tshe sangs rgyas la chos kyo nas myang zos mngon du byed pa yod de/ de ltar rang rgyal gyi myang 'das mngon du byed pa med kyang nyan thos kyi myang ladas mngon du byed pa yod pa'i sgyid der thal/ rang rgyal ma nges pa'i rigs can de 'dra byed pa yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can kha cig ces pa'i rnam bcad dang yongs gcod re yod pa'i phyigyang kha cig /rang rgyal dgra bcom yin na/ 'dir bshad pa ltar gyi bsod nams dang ye shes 'phel ba'i khyad par dang ldan pas khyab zer na/ gcig car ba dang rgyud gcig tu gyur pa'i rang rgyal chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyig der thal/ smon lam dbang gis srid pa tha ma'i tshe sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang ma 'phrad na rang rgyal dgra bcom go 'phang mngon du byed pa gcig dbu sems kun bzhed pa'i phyir te/ kun btus las/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba med na rang rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'grel pa bud+dha pā li ta las/ 'di ltar der zhugs pa rnams kyis bdag nyid mngon sum du 'phyal kho na la 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa nas/ ji lte yang 'di la cung zad goms par byas pa rnams la brgya la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ma byung ba'am/ nyan thos rnams kyang zad par gyur te snun dang mi ldan par gyur tu zin na yang de dag gis sngon goms pa'i rgyu las byung ba rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gzhan las shes pa min pa bsten pa med pa tsam gyi rkyen las rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab nye/ brgya la rdzogs pa'i 27
sems bskyed dang po/sangs rgyas ma byung ba'am zhes srid mtha' tsam du bshad pas shugs la sangs rgyasadang nyan thos byungan rang rgyal du mi 'gyur bar bshad pa'i phyiradang/ tshig gsal las kyang] ji ste ji zhig ltar rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams ma byung zhing] zhes pa nas/ rang 'byung rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni brten pa med bar rab tu skye ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyig khyab ste/ rang rgyal rigs nges rnamasanan gyis smon lamadabang gis sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa kho nar 'bus bu mngon du byed pas brgya laman zhesadang] ji ltar ji zhig ltar na zhes stesadabang gis srid pa tsam du ston don med pa'i phyir ro/ /'des ni rnam bshad las rang rgyal gyi rigs can kha cig ces pa'i don/ nyan thos 'phags pa rang rgyal lam du mi 'jug zer ba khegs so/ /'di dag la lung rigs kyi sgrub byed shin tu mang ngo / /yang kha cig /rang rgyal rgyud kyi tshogs gnyis tshogs yin zed la las de'i rgyud kyi tshogs med zed gzhan dag tshogs mtshan nyid pa min pa la tshogs kyi tha snyad med zer ba sogs kyi log rtog mngayod /de rnams mi lan par thal/ rang rgyal rgyud kyi tshogs gnyis yod kyang tshogs mtshan nyid pa min/ de'i rgyud kyi brtsod nams sogs la tshogs kyi tha snyad mdo las bshad pa'i sgyigadang 4 grub ste/de'i rgyud kyi tshogs gnyisade tshogs mayin pa'i pyidader thal/ rang rgyal la tshogs gnyis mtshan nyid pa med pas de sangs rgyas las dman pa'i phyir te/rang 'grel las/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sogs med pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig des na dpal ldan zla bas tshogs ma yin par bshad pa de'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa grub lte/ de tsam du ma zad bsodanams dang ye shes sbyi tsam la tshogs kyi sgras bsnyad pa mang du yod kyang/ de dag las 'bras bu gzugs sku'i lag rjes lasdog byed kyi don yod pa tshogs mtshan nyid pa dang] de med padag tshogs btags pa ba'am phal bsan pa'i phyig der thal/ klu sgrub yab sras dang rje rin po che slob dasan seng bzang sogs kyidagongs pa 28
nyan rang thub dbang las skyes tshul/yin pa'i phyig blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/nyan thos kyi ltabu mayin pa sgyin pa'i bsodanams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang/ tshul khrims kyi bsemad nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang] thos pa nyung ba la chos skya nan tan byed pa dang] sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la yang rim zo dang bsnyen bkur byed pa la yang zhum pa med cing dbang po bar ma lte/ zhes dngan 'di dang mthun pad rnam bshad las/ ba〈snadanamasadangawe shes sbyo la tshogs kyi sgra 'jug paspend kyang tshogs kyi sgra 'jug ༵ shā /sna ༵/na )pa r+sha ༵/sapa /༷ sdu/naX rlo ༷༵ sna misna ༵ k+ṣiṃ shāmi thapa pa sprapa ba ni tshogs phal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyidgnyis pa rang lugs la/ nyan rang dgra bcom gnyis rang rgyu thub dbang las skyes tshul yod de/ sngon slob pa'i lam gyi tshe zub dbang gi rten 'brel zab po'i chos 'os pas rang gi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu rdzogs pade brnyes pa'i pyid rtags grub zin/ rang rgyal dgra bcom rnams srid pa tha ma'i tshe sangs rgyas lta ci/ gzhan gyis brjod pa'i ngag tsam la'ang ma brten par dur khrod kyi rus gong lta bu tsam la dmigs nas rten 'brel yan lag lugs 'byung ldog tu dpyad nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed kyang de rang rgyu thub dbang gsung gis bskyed pa yin te/ tshe shā pa k+tarnyit+na du /byi (9 spra ༵༵༵ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༷sdu dz+nyo ༈ spra/ ༷dī sta pa/bsna sna/lha sprapa shā gal te 'dig /mya ngan 'das pa ma 'ob kyang / /skye ba gzhan du 'bad med pag /thob 'gyur nges pa'i las bzhin no/ /zhes dngaka dbu ma las kyang/ rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams ma byung zhing/ /nyan 'os rnams kyang zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni/ /brten pa med par rab tu skye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisatheg spru chung ngu'idagrabacom chos can/ khyod la ga thosadang thos slog tu 'bod 29
sems bskyed dang po/pa'i rgyu mtshan yodade/ gzhan la gdams ngag nyananas rang gis 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe/ gzhan la sgrog pasan nyan thosadang/theg chen ñcha lam 'bras gzhan las thos nas rang gis nyams su cung zad kyang mi len par gzhan la slog pas na thos slog tu brjod pa yin pa'i phyig theg pa 'bring gi dgra bcom chos can/ khyod la de nyid rtogs 'tsheng zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de nyid rtogs pa'i 5theg pa gsum lnga'i mi slob pa la 'jug cing] khyod bskal chen brgya la bsesnadanams dang ye shes la goms pa bsring nus pas nyan thos las lhag cing / tshogs gnyis dang snying rje chen 4 khyad par can dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa med pas sangs rgyas las dman pas na 'bring zhes brjod pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ rang rgyal rnams ni bskal pa brgyag zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas las dman pas na 'bring ngo] /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig des na/ nyan thos de nyid rtogs 'byeng thub dbang skyes/ /zhes bsgyur dgos te/ nyan rang la sangs rgyas su 'dir ma grags pa'i phyig nyan rang la tshogs mtshan nyid pa med de/ nyan rang mi slob pa la tshogs gnyis kyi lag rjes mtshan dpe med pa'i phyig khyab ste/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku 'di/ /bsesnadanams tshogs las zhakhrungs pa yin/ /zhes dang/ rin chen phreng ba las/ de lta bas na tshogs 'di gnyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'job pa'i rgyu/ /zhes dang/ de bzhin du 'grel pa don gsal las kyang / yang dag par 'grub pa'i ngo bos byang chub chen 4 'dzin par byed pa'i phyiran snying rje chen po la sogs pa tshogasasan pas zhes gsungs pa'i phyis tshogs kyi sgra bshad kyang de yin te/ de'i skad dod bha ra la yi ge saṃ bsnan pas saṃ las yang dag par 'grub pa 'on/ bha lasango bos byang chub chen po thon/ ra las 'odzin par byed pa 'on pa'i phyir te/ nyan rang la khur du gabyer ba'i snying rje chen po med par mtshungs kyang / bsam pa dang rigs dang dbang po sogs la khyad med du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ de'i gong du dge ba bcu'i 30

sems bskyed dang po/zhes brjod pa ma yin nam/ de'i phyir ji ltar na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrangs she na/ zhes byung/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang zhes pas nyan rang zhakhrungs par ma zad ces bstan/ skyes par gyur pas rgyal ba'i sras zhes pa gnyis dogs pa'i gtso 4 yin no/ /lan la spyir de'i sras la khyod kyi 'dod pa de ltar gsung las zhabrungs pa'i gnas bzhag pa gcigadang/ rgyud 'jug las/de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /zhes pa lta bu pha'i sa 'on dang mtshungs pa'i thabs kyi sgo nas sras su bzhag pa gcigadang] 'dini de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rigs su'ang skyes pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltabu shes rab khyad par can gyi sgonasade'i sras su bzhag pa gcigadang gsum sogasaphungad pas/gsung las skyes pa'i sras su bzhag tshog pa bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang kho 'os theg pa gsum gyi ṭ+wāṃ ñcha ༵ shārnyipa (1 m+p+raṃ snroX ༵ ñcha ṇā ༵ sdu ༷ paji ñja gh+nā pa( shā1 ༷snyi rnyisna kau ts+tsha /dpa / 'grel las/ bden mod kyi 'on kyang zhes pa'idangos shugasadang skabasadon tshogs pa'i lan yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam bshad las kyang/ de ltaran sangs rgyas kyis nye bar bstan pa las byang sems skye ba yin kyang thub dbang skyes skabs su de la nyan rang ltar mi dgos te/ de gnyis thub dbang las skyes par ston pa ni de gnyis kyi rtsab yang mthar gtugs na snying rje la zug par bstan pa'i phyir yin la/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig sangs rgyas rnams byang sems las 'khrangs zhes ba la skyon med par ma zad shin tu 'thadade/de lung rigs du mas grub pa'i phyis rang 'grel las/ de'i phyir de ltar na rigs pa dang lung dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byang chub sems dpa' ༵༵ ༵ pa dris /sa/ / spra pa hūm̐ ṅgi ṭā smur+sha pa shāsdi (/ rgyu/shā lhar+sha ]pa~X (pa 〉pa /lha pa k+ṣiṃ] 34
nyan rang thub dbang las skyes tshul/rangadang rgyud tha dad pas lhan cig byed rkyen byed bde'i pyid dang 4 grub ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs sngon du song ba can kho na yin ba'i phyid dperan/ bdag cag gi ston pa de bram ze khye'u snang byed dang/ rgyal po rab gsal dang] nga las nu sogs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs rim gyis brgyudanas 'og min du sangs rgyas pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ 'on kyang rgyu gnyis kyi zhes pa nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas skabs ni byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs kyi rgyu canayin pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid gnyis pa grub ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis dang por zugs bskyed pa sogs la sangs rgyas bzhugs mi bzhugs kyi dus kun tu byang sems kyis yongs 'odzin dang rkyen mdzad nas rgyal sras kyi lam la bcug pa sha stag yin par mdo du ma las bshad pa'i mig dper na sngon 'phags pa 'jam dpal byang sems su gyur nas bdag cag gi ston pa dang de las gzhan pa'i ches mang po la byang chub kyi sems 'dzin du bcug pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las yang dag par 'odzin du 'jug pa las ni ji ltar 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpar gyur pa nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dngade las gzhan pa'ide bzhin gshegs ba rnams ches thog ma kho nar byang chub kyi sems yang dag par bedzin du bcug par 'don pa yin no/ /zhes byung/ de ltar zhakhrungs par bshad pa la rgyu mtshan chen 4 yod de/ byang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen gnyis byed par sho nas skal ldan lam der 'jug pa dang mi ldog pa dang spro ba sogs kyi rgyu mtshan mang 4 yod pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ de'i phyir de ltar 'gras bu mthar thug pade'i rgyu'i gtso bor gyur pa la ltos nasade bzhin gshegs pa rnams byang sems las zhakhrungs par bltan rto/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiga'on/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bsngags pa gtso bor ma brjod par 'der byang sems la brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhen/ de la rgyu mtshan du ma 35
sems bskyedadang po/yod de/ byang sems rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyu gces pa yin padang/ byang sems la bstod pas sangs rgyas la'ang bstod par shugs kyis 'gro ba dang] sman gyi ldon shing gzhon nu gces par bskyangs rigs pa bzhin sangs rgyas skya ldon shing gi myu gu byang sems gces par bskyangs rigs pa dang dus der 'dus pa'i zeg pa gsum gyi rigs can theg chen la sbyar ba'i dgos pa bzhi'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ de nyid kyi phyir rgyu phun sum tshogs pa zhes pa nas/ byang sems la bsngags pa mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes byung/don 'di dag lung gis kyang grub ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/'od srung 'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba tshes pa la phyag 'tshal ba ltar nya ba la ma yin no/ /'od srung de bzhin du gang dag nga la rab tu dang ba de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag bya yi/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhen/ byang chub semasadapa' rnams las nide bzhin gshegs pa 'byungango] /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las ni nyad 'osadang rang sangs rgyas thams cad 'byungayod /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cigan re/ byang sems rnams rgyal ba las 'khrungs par thal/ rang rgyu rgyal ba las 'khrungs pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o na/ rgyal ba tshos can/ rgyal ba las zhakhrungs par thal/ rang rgyu rgyal ba las zhakhrungs pa'i phyid khyab pa khas/ gdod na/ de chos can/khyod khyod las ma zhakhrungs par thal/ khyod bdag med yin pa'i phyig yang kha cig/rgyal ba'i sras rgyal ba las 'khrangs kyang rgyal srasade las ma 'khrungs pa'i khyad par phye ba la/ kha cigan re/ rgyal ba'i sras gcig med par thal/ tshogs lam pa de yang de ma yin pa nas/ sa bcu pa ba de yang de ma yin pa'i sgyir zeran/'o na/ rgyal ba las 'khrangs pa'i byang sems gcig med par thal/ byang sems tshogs lam bdesangade masan pa nas/ sa bcu ba bdeyang de masan pa'i pyid khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ khyod du gyur pa'i rgyal ba'i nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen du ma yod pa'i 36
nyan rang thub dbang las skyes tshul/pyid rtags khyod kyis khas blangs so/ /'on kyang rgyal ba las zhakhrungs pa la zugs rtsegatad cing brjod bde khyad byedan ma gtogs rgyal ba'i srasadang rgyal sras la khyad par medade/ mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' semasadapa' che/ /blo ldan nyid dang gsal ba'i mchog /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi dngani/ /rgyal byed rgyal ba'i myu gudang] /zhes rtsogs rnam grangasayin cing] rgyal ba'i sras po 'diyam̐ sems gang 'gro ba rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig yang kha cig na re/skabs 'dor rtsod pa'i rgyal sras su lasag pa yang kun rdzob byang semasadang/donadam byang sems kyi sgo nasader bzhag payin zhes lan btab tshog par thal/ sbyor rgyal sras su 'jog pa la byang chub skya sems gnyisadang gsung las zhakhrungs padang]de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras sgra gcan 'dzin zhes pa ltar rus bskyed pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ 'dir gsung las bskyed tshul la rtsod skabasasan pa'i phyiradangakarang 'grel las kyang] byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyangade bzhin gshegs pas nye bar bstan pa las skyes par gyur pas rgyal ba'i sras zhes brjod pa min nam/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyiradang] dkon brtsegs kyidon yang yod pa'i nyidbyas ba la kho na re/ 'on/ shā ri'i bu chos can/ rgyal ba'i sras yin par thal/ rgyal ba'i gsung las skyes pa'i phyig der thal/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i gsung las skyes pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/de'i slob mdangagasung las skyes pa la bu 'am sras kyi tha snyada' da kyang rgyal sras zhes pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas lasdogadagos pa'i phyig yang kha cig /byang semasawenan rgyal ba dang rgyud gcigasan pas khyab zer na/ rgyal ba'i gdul bya'i byang sems rgyal ba dang dus mnyam pa chos can/ rgyal ba dang rgyud gcig yin par thal/ byang sems yin pa'i sgyig khyab pa khas/rtags grub lte/ de yod ba'i phyig rgyal bas chos dngor bskor yul gyi rigs can gsum yod pa'i phyig 'dod mi nus/ gzhan yang/ sems can yinan/ rgyal bdang rgyud gcigasanadagos 37
sems bskyed dang po/par thal/ rgyal sras la de'i phyid gdodan/ mnges pa'i rigs canadang nges pa'i rigs canadang nyan rang sogs re re nas chos can/ der thal/ de'i pyig khyab pa khas/ 'dodan/ rgyal ba chos can/ khyod ma nges pa'i rigs can sangs rgyas pa'i rgyal bar thal/ khyod de dang rgyud gcig pa'i rgyal ba yin pa'i phyig rtags sesnang] der thal/ de dang rgyud gcig gang zhig /rgyal ba yin pa'i pyid byas pa la khon re/ rgyal bdang rgyud thadad pa'i byang sems yod par thal/ medod pa'i phyigmedod na/de rnam mkhyenadang rgyud thadad pa'ide yin par thal/ ladod pa'i phyis 'dod na/des rnam mkhyen thob tshul med par thagade rnam mkhyenadang rgyud thadad pasan pa'i pyiran ma khyab/ khyab par thal/ rgyud thadad pa'i rnam mkhyen thob tshul med pa'i phyir na yang ma khyab ste/ rang dang rgyud gcig pa'i rnam mkhyen yod pa de 'jub par 'gyur ba yin pa'i phyid byas pa la kho na re/ rnam mkhyen de de dang rgyud thadad pa'i rnam mkhyen yin par thal/ de rnam mkhyen dang rgyud tha dad yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ rnam mkhyenadede dang rgyud gcig dang tha dad pa'i rnam mkhyen gang rung du khas len mi rigs pa'i phyirate/ de lade yin min gnyis yod pa'i phyisyang 'od kha cig na re/ 'grel ba'i lan des pha rol gyi dogs pa de mi chod par thal pha rol rtsod smra bas byang sems rnams rgyal sras yin pas byang sems rgyal ba las 'khrangs par bshad rigs kyi/ bzlogs nas mi rigs zhes pa la 'grel par bden kha byin pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ de ltar zhakhrungs kyang byang sems las sangs rgyas nyakhrangs par da dung bshad dgos pa'i sgyid zhes pa'i rtsod tshul 'chad pas rnam bshad las/ phyogs snga ma smra bas byang sems rnams rgyal ba'i srasasan pas/ zhes panas/dogs pa mi chod pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ zhes byung]dogs pa de mi chod pa'i skyon med par thal/ 'grel par rgyal sras 'ga' zhig gis nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen byasanas sangs rgyas bar bshad pa na/ sangs rgyasade'i sras byang semasade las 38
byang sems kyi rgyu'i gtso bo gsum 'chad pa/sangs rgyas de 'khrungs pa ma yin par shes pas 'grel pas khyod kyis zer ba ltar bden kha ma byin pa'i phyig der thal/ dper na bdag cag gi ston pa'i gsung las skyes pa'i byang sems de bdag cag gi ston pa'i srasayin kyang/ byang semasade las bdag cag gi ston pa ma zhakhrungs par shes pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ skyon 'di med de zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas de'i sras yin kyang byang sems de las sangs rgyas de zhabrungs pa ma yin pas rtsod pa de ni tshul de gnyis rnam par ma phyed pa'i rtsod par 'grel pas lan btab pa la brten nas shes rab yod na ci'i phyir mi rtogs/ zhes gsungs pa'i miggsum pa byang sems kyi rgyu'i gtso bo gsum 'chad par byed pa la/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang] /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes byung/ de las dang kho snying rje'i sems snying rje 'chad pad rang 'grel las/ snying rje ni zhes sogs byung] gnyis su med ces pa'i gnyis med kyi blo 'chad pag rang 'grel las/ gnyis su med pa'i blo ni zhes sogs byung / byang chub kyi sems shes byed dang bcas 'chad pag rang 'grel las/ byang chub kyi sems ni 'phags pa chos kun 'phro ba'i mdo las/ zhes pa nas/ ji skad bstan pa bzhin no/ /zhes byung /de'i grub don de gsum byang sems kyi rgyu'i gtso 'or 'chad pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gtso bo'i rgyu ni/ zhes pa nas/ gsum po 'di dag yin no/ /zhes byung / shes byed 'chad pagji skad ma rin chen phreng ba las/ zhes pa nas/ zhes gsungs so/ /zhes byung]'di la spyi don dang mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ sngar nyan rang thub dbangadang de byang sems las zhakhrungs par bshad na/ der ma zad byang sems rgyu'i gtso 'o gang las zhakhrungs she na/ de rnams rang rgyu chos gsum las lubrungs zhes 'chad par/ snying rje'i sems dang zhes sogs rkang pa 39
sems bskyed dang po/gnyis byung lte/ rang 'grel las/ yang byang chub sems dpa' de dag ci'i rgyu can yin zhe na snying rje'i sems dang nas/ zhes bya ba smos so/ /zhes dang / rnam bshad las kyang / gal te nyan rang gnyis zhes pa nas/ byang sems rnams kyi gtso bo'i rgyu yinano/ /zhes byungaka 'grel parayang byang chub sems dpa' zhes pa'i yang sgra ni rtsaba'i dang sgra gnyis kyi 'grel pa yin te/ yang dang dang la spyaX /phyi khri two ṭ+wāṃ spri ༷ ༷ lha ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ṭ+wāṃ // m+p+raṃ twi /༷ hūm̐ ༷༷ 9smo smo spya dz+nyo raṃ rnyirnyi lha gh+nā sna ༵ ma/spya ( m+p+raṃ /tsho tshosnad gh+nā yi/ k+to/ dzī dzī dzī ༵༵༵dpa dbang rgyal 4 ltar brtan dang] /phyogs mthas gshugs pa'i snying rje dang] /gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags/ /zhes smyung/ṇ+ḍar bstan snying rje chos can/ ngo 'o rnam pa dbye ba rnams yod de/ 'chad 'gyur ltar ngo 'o n+d+ra /( /sna pa/ 〉spra /shā rnyi]zlo snashā shālha ༵ /spya /shā ṅgi (pa sdi ṅgi papa zlos snyi sbyo rnyi ny+pha ñcha /sna / dmigs yul 'char tshul gyi sgo nas sems can tsam dang chos dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje gsum yod pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ de la snying rje ni brtseb ste 'di nyid du 'gad par 'gyur ba'i rnam ba dang rang gi ngo 'o canano/ /zhes byung] rnam bshad las kyangaka 'chad par 'gyur ba'i snying rje'i sems dang zhes pas dbye ba yang grub pa'i 9ga 'dir bstan gnyis med kyi blo chos can/ dmigs pa rnam pa dbye ba rnams yod de/ dmigs pa chos dang gang zag la dmigs nas dngos 'odangadangos med kyi mtha' gnyis 4 sogs las rnam pa gzhanadangacand 40
byang sems kyi rgyu'i gtso bo gsum 'chad gamed mtha' gnyisadang rtag chad kyi med pa'i stong pa'i rnam pa can/ dbye ba byang sems lasadang 4 ba'ilang sngon du 'phro ba gcig dang] mos rgyud skabs kyi gcigadang] sa thob pa'i gnyis med kyi blo dang gsum yod pa'i phyig dmigs rnam ni/ rang 'grel las/ gnyis su med pa'i blo ni dngos 4 dang dngos 4 med pa la sogs pa mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i shes rab bo/ /zhes dang] rnam bshad las/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i shes rab la bshad la/ de yang byang sems kyi sngon du 'ong ba mi 'gal 'on/ /zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med blo zhes pas thog mar zhugs pa'i byang sems kyi rgyu'i shes rab kyang ston dgos pas so/ /zhes byung / kyang sgras byang sems kyi sngon 'gro'i de gtso 'or bstan par ma zad byang sems skye 'phags dus kyide yang bstan zhes bshadadagos pa'i phyis 'di'i shes byed/ rin chen 'phreng bad gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab lte/ ye shes zhes pa gtso 'or 'phags pa la bh+yoradagos la 'grel parade'idangos shugs gnyis ma'i don bshad pa yin pa'i phyig sems bskyed dang snying rje'i skabs su yang zin byed gnyis med kyi blo re bshad pa'i phyis 'dir bstan sems bskyed chos can/dmigs rnam ngo bo dbye ba rnamasaphungad de/ dmigs pa gzhanadonadang byang chub chen po ladamigs nas ched du bya ba sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam bde thob par 'dod pa/ngo 4 gnyis med kyi blo dang snying rje chen pos drangs pa'i yid kyi rnam shesadang/dbye ba byang sems lasadang 4 ba'i rdzon 'ju lam ma zhugs kyi bur shun sgya ro lta bu'i sems bskyedanas byang sems skye 'phags kyi rgyud kyi smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis rnams yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ byang chub kyi sems ni 'grel par mdo drangs pa las bstan pa yin zhes gsungs la/ mdo las ni rang gi chos kyi de kho na nyid rtogasanas chos nyid 'do sems can rnams kyis khong du chud par bya'o snyam nas gang sems skyes padeni byang chub kyi sems serdzo//zhes gsungs dreg//mngon rtogs rgyan las gsungs 44
sems bskyedadang po/padang 'di la mi 'dra ba med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis snying rje so so'i skabs su sems bskyed tshul re bshad pas ni sems bskyed kyi dbye ba bshad zin ltar 'grub pa'i phyig 'grel par mdo drangs pas sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs paradangos su ma bstan te/ ched du bya ba'i gzhan don thabs shes gnyis kyis zin par dngos su bstan nas rang don byang chub shugs la bstan pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ 'di ni sems bskyed kyi ched du bya ba'i phyogs gcig tsam la dmigs pasan pas mtshan nyid ma rdzogs la/zhes gsungs pa'i gyisade ltar yinate/ mdo las/byang chub sems dpas byang chub kyi sems las byang chub kyi chos thams cad khong du chud par bgyi'o/ /nas/ byang chub kyi sems zhes bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi mdor bstan/ thabs phan bde bla med kyi sems dang tshad med bzhis rim bzhin mnyen pa dang/ mi ldog pa dang] 'gyod pa med pa dngan chags snang gi dri ma med pas zin tshulayang bstan la/shes rab stong mtshan smon med kyi blo gsum gyis zin tshul yang bltan pa'i pyid dang 4 grub ste/ mdo las/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang] bla na med pa'i sems dang/ byams pas mnyen pa'i sems dang] snying rjes mi ldog pa'i sems dang dga' bas 'akyod pa ma mchis pa'i sems dang btang snyoms kyis dri ma ma mchis pa'i sems dang/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dis ni sems bskyed la tshad med bzhis zin tshul yang shes par gyis/gnyis pa grub ste/ mdo las/ stong pa nyid kyis mi 'gyur ba'i sems dang] mtshan ma med pas sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i sems dang] smon pa med pas mi gnas pa'i sems/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lenas ni gnyis med kyi slo la rnam thar sgo gsum gyi shes rab dang des sems bskyed zin tshul yang shes par gyis/'dir bstan chos gsum sgya go rim yod de/ dbang rnon gyis lam rgyud la skyed tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ gnyis med kyi blo dang snying rje chen 4 sems bskyed gsum rim gyis bskyed 42
byang sems kyi rgyu'i gtso bo gsum 'chad pa/pa'i phyig der thal/ theg chen gyi rigs can dbang rnon de mang du thos pa'i gang zag yin pas lha'or ba'i rtsab ma rig pa la thug gi bar shesanas/de slong nus mi nus legs par dbyad pas ma rig pa zhen yul med pa'i log shes spong nus su mthong ba na sems bskyed pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ byang chub kyi sems ni 'phags pa chos kun 'ju ba'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpas byang chub kyi sems las chos thams cad khong du chud par bgyi'o/ /nas/shes pa pos stong pa'i phyir yongs su shes par bgyi ba tsam du bas na chos nyid 7do ltabu lade sems sman rnams kyi khong du chud par bya'o snyamanas byang chub semasadapa' la sems gang skyes pa 'deni byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / dbu ma rgyan las/ yang dag shes 'tshol sngon btang ste//donadam rnam paranges gyuranas//ltangan tshob gnas 'jig rten la/ /snying rje kun nas bskyed nas su/ /'gro don byed pa dpa' gyur pa/ /byang chub blo rgyas mkhas pa ni/ /blo dang snying rjes brgyan pa yis/ /zub pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag spyod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyigdbang rtul langes pa medade/dbang rtul tshig rjes lan bayin pas 'og mar sems bskyedanas stong nyid tshol ba yang yod la/ stong nyid rtogs nas sems bskyed pa'ang 'byung ba'i phyir te/ dbu ma rgyan las/ yang dag dad pa'i rjes 'brang ba/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /〈ba pa'i brtul zhugs blangs byas te/ /de ni yang dag shes 'tshol brtson/ /zhesadang] snying ṭo rgyan las/ sems ma bskyed pa'i snga rol tu stong nyid rtogs pa gron du 'gro dgos pa ni non po la yin gyi shul 4 la ni nges pa med de/ zhes gsungs pa'i 9gagnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la kha cig na re/ 'dir bstan tshos gsum 4 la byang sems tshogs lam thob ma thag pa'i gron du bskyed rgyu'i yon tan gyis khyab zer na/ 'o na/ 'der bstan snying rjede yin na/ byang sems rgyud kyi snying rje chen 4 ma yin pas khyab par thal/dam bca' de'i 43
sems bskyed dang po/phyis khyab ste/ lam ma zhugasadang/ byang sems skabasadangan sangs rgyas sa'i skabs su thob rgyu'i yon tan gsum 'gal ba kho nayin pa'i phyigader thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sar thob rgyu'i yon tan lam ma zhugs na 'job pa dpe la mi srid ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod mi nus te/ 'dir bstan snying rje chen po la 'chad 'gyur ltar ngo bo'i sgo nas sems can chosadamigs med la dmigs pa'i snying sbyo shāshā dz+nyo kā/rdzu (smi sna pa'i ༵ ༵ cadri /rnyi /nā sprag (parnyi parnyi m+p+raṃ dī spyad ༈ k+ṣiṃ rnyi // 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rnam padang rang gingo 'o can no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhanalang]'dir bstan sems skyed pa 4 la byang sems gcig med par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i 3ga'dod mi nus te/ rang 'grel du mdo drangs pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' la sems gang skye ba 'di ni byang chub semasadapa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gzhan yang/ byang chub semasani rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes pa'idangos bstan gyi byang sems la byang sems tshogs lam pas khyab par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyid 'dod na/ de la thub dbang dngos su skyed pa'i byang sems gcig kyang med par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ de la shubadabang rang lasadangos su zhakhrungs pa'i byang sems sa bcu pa ba gcig kyangazungad pa'i phyir te/rnam bshad las/ gal te nyan rang gnyis shubadabang las dang] chubadabang rnams byang sems las zhakhrungs na byang sems dedag gi rgyu gangasan zhe na/ 'tshad par 'gyur ba'i snying rje'i sems dang/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig yang go shāka sogs kha cig/'dir bstan sems bskyed zeg chen sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa dang] 'der bstan byang sems de byang 'phags la byed zer na/'o na/'dir bstan snying rjes drangs te sems bskyed pa'i sems bskyed de yin na/ bh+yor lam pa yan chad rgyud kyidesanadagos par thal/de lasadangos su zhakhrungs pa'i 'dir bstan byang semasasan 44
byang sems kyi rgyu'i gartsa bo gsum 'chad pa/na/ byang 'phags yin dgos pa'i phyig rtags khas/ ma grub na/ gshor gsum/ 'dir bstan byang sems la so skye gcig yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyig gzhur gsum/ rtsabar 'dod na/ de ltar sems bskyed pa'i tshogs lam zob ma thag pa'i 'jug pa'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i rgyud skya 'dir bstan sems bskyed chos can/ der thal/ de'i mig lha'or gsum/ rtags grub ste/ de yod pa'i phyig der thal/ thog mar gal che ba'i snying rjes drangs pa'i tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'dir bstan sems bskyed yod pa'i pyid rang 'grel las/ 'di ltar snying rje can gyis gzhan r+nghi ༷ ༷ lci smyu ༷ shaṃ two ༷༷༷ sh+lau )smi smo two pa/ ṭ+wāṃ traṃ ༷༷ /nga pyā gsungs pa'i 9ga kha cig/rang 'grel sgya gzhung 'dis bstan pa'i sems bskyedasanan/ sems bskyedasan pas khyab zer na yang mi lanade/ 'on/ 'dir bstan sems bskyedasan na/ bcos min gyi phyong ba 'on bas khyab par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i gyid 'dod na/ de la rtsol bcas kyi myong ba bur shun gyi ro ltabu'i sems bskyed gcig med par thal/ lajud ba'i pyid gdodan/de la sems bskyed bsgom dus kyide 'dra gcig med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyig 'dod na/ de la 'dir bstan byang sems tshogs lam thob ma thag pa'i gron du 'gro rgyu'i sems bskyed gcig med par thal/ 'dod pa'i nyid 'dod 'i nus lte/snying rje chen po thog mar gal che tshulamangad ba'i mig khyab lte/ byang sems rnams kyis 'og mar sems bskyed pa yang snying rje la rag las pas snying rje thog mar gal che bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ byang sems kyi sngon du 'phro ba'i sems bskyedani sems bskyed bsgom pa'i skabs ladagongs kyi/ zhes panas/ sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam ba tsamani tshig rjes lan ba'i go ba tsamasan pas bur shing gi shun pa'i rodang 45
sems bskyed dang po/'dra lte/ de la sems bskyed zer yang sems bskyed dngos ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigyang kha cig/bcos min gyi snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyedayin na/ sems bskyedayin pas khyab zer na/'on/ lam ma zhugasan sems bskyed mtshan nyid pasku(da par thal/ de na de ltar sems bskyed pa yod pa'i phyig khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ snying rje chen po rgyud la skyes nas sems bskyed rgyud la ma skyes pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyig der thal/ snying rje chen po la bcos min gyi myong pa thon nas sems bskyed la bcos min gyi myong ba ma thon pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun rgyud la skye tshul dang snying rje chen po thog mar gal che tshul yod pa'i pyir dang / sems bskyed na sems bskyed rgyud la skyes pas ma khyab pa'i phyir sogs mang do /yang sems bskyed yin na/ sgom byung yin pas khyab snyam na/ 'o na/ bur shun gyi ro 'dra'i sems bskyed de bsam byung gi blo yin par thal/ 'dod pa de 'thad pa'i mig 'dod mi nus te/de thos byung gi blo yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ tshig rjes 'brang ba'i go ba tsam yin pas/zhes sogs gsungs pa'i pyig khyab lte/ bsam byung yin na tshig rjes 'brang ba'i go bar 'gal ba'i pyid der thal/ thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab gsum gyi khyad par yod pa'i pyid gzhan yangad bur shun gyi ro 'dra'i de thos byung yin par thal/ sems bskyed bsgom pa'i tshe thos bsam rim gyis 'byung ba mdo sde rgyan ltar yin pa'i pyig der thal/ sems bskyed de dang 4 tshig spyi la brten nas sgom pa'i tshe de la thos blos bsgom skabs yin pa'i phyis der thal/ de la tshig la brten mi dgos par 'gro sdod dang sems can mthong tshe bsgom pa ltar sems ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes 'ong tshe sems bskyed rgyud la skyes tshar pa'i phyig khyab nye/ de'i tshe de la bsam byung gi skabasayin gyi sgom byung ma thob pa'i phyigader thal/ de'i tshe sems bskyed bsgom pa'i bloyin na/ mnyam bzhag gi sas bsdus ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyig der thal/ de'i tshe sems bskyed 46
byang sems kyi rgyu'i gtso bo gsum 'chad pa/steng nas zhi gnas ma thob pa'i phyis khyab ste/ bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs ma 'ob bar du sgom byung mi 'ong bar lam rim las bshad pa'i phyig tsaba'i ma khyab mtshams la rtags grub lte/ rnam bshad las/ byang chub skya sems sbyo nga ba'i mnangag bzhin du sbyangs pa la brten nasasad legs par gsal thub pa'i myong ba khyad par can skyes pa ni shun pa'i nang gi bur shing dngos kyi ro dang 'dra bas sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa yin te/ zhes dang] mdo las/ ji ltar shun pa de bzhin smra ba ste/ /ro ltabu ni 'di la don sems yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid lung 'dis kyang smra ba zhes pas tshig sbyide bshad/don sems zhes pas tshig spyi masan paradon la sems pa gcig bshad kyang sgom byung ma bshad pas so/ /rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung gangana'ang snying rje sems bskyed nges 'byung dad pa sogs la sgom byung dgos par bshad pa tshig zur tsam yang med do/ /der ma zad sems gnas dgu'i dang po 'os pa dang lhag ma bsam pa dang bsam byung yin kyang sgomasan la sgom byung ma yin pa dang sgom byung thob pa la shin sbyangs dgos par lam rim las bshad la sems bskyed la de tsam sgom mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig /'dir bstan byang semasalgen na/ stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyab par thal/ byang sems dbang po rno rtul gang rung yin na/ stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyab pa'i phyir zer na ma khyab/rtags grub nye/ sems tsam par gyur pa'i byang sems 'angad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ slob dpon phyogs glang de de yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ gal te gnas brtan dbyig gnyen dang /phyogs kyi glang po dang / chos skyong la sogs pa bstan bcos mdzad pa 4 byon zin par gyur pa de dag gis kyang yi ge tsam thos pas 'jigs te/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don phyin ci ma log par ston pa 'di spangs sam zhe na de skad du smra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang] phyogs kyi glang 4 gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa can dang] zhes gzhan phan byang sems yod par bshad pa'i 47
sems bskyed dang po/phyid rtsabar 'dod na/ byang sems dbang po rno rtul gang rung yin na/ 'der bstan byang sems yin dgos par thal/ ladod pa'i phyis gdod mi nus te/ ṇ+ḍar theg chen rigs nges dbang rnon gyi lam bzod tshulasan pa'i phyigader thal/'dir bstan byang sems rnams rang rgyu chos gsum las 'khrungs pa'i phyig rang 'grel las/ yang byang chub semasadapa'ade dag ci'i rgyu canayin zhe na/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dngaka /zhes sogs dang yang rang 'grel las/ dam bca' ba 'di yang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spangs pas bsgrub par mi nus pas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kho na la yang 'jug ste/ zhes dang] sngar sems bskyed tshul gyi mdo don rnams grub pa'i phyid gzhan yang / 'jug pa'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya la stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyig 'dod mi nus te/ 'jug pa'i bshad pa ltar lam nyams su len pa la stong nyid rtogasadagos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bod snga ma kha cigan re/ skabs 'de'i gnyis med kyi blo gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi blo la byed zeran/ 'de'i gnyis po de gzung 74na gnyis dang med tshul de rdzas gzhan du med pa dang yul yul can rgyang chad du med pa ci rigs su 'jog rigs par thal/dam bca' 'thad pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ de mtha' gnyis dang] der ma grub pa la rim bzhin byed pa'i phyis rang 'grel las/gnyis su med pa'i bloni dngos sodangadangos 4 med pa la sogs pa'i mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i shes rab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang rnam bshad las/ gnyis su med ba'i slo ni gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba med pa min gyi 'grel par mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i shes rab la bshad la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang 'grel bshad mkhan ṭo na re/ 'dor bstan chos gsum yodade/ byang sems rgyud kyi snying rjedang/don dam sems bskyed du gyur pa'i gnyis med kyi blodangaka rags pa brda' las byung ba'i sems bskyed gsum la lasdog pa'i phyig zhes 'dod 48
byang sems kyi rgyu'i gtso bo gsum 'chad pa/de/ 'grel bshad las/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyi snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems dang don dam pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i blodang brda' las byung ba'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni rgyu yin zhes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyiga'on/ 'dir bstan chos gsum po de la lam du zhugs ma thag pa'i rgyu re med par thal/ 'dir bstan gnyis med kyi blodonadam sems bskyedasan pa'i migartagasadangos/ 'dodan/ rang 'grol las/ yangadag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnam pas kyang 'og mad bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen 4 sangs rgyas nyid kyi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa dang po sems can dngor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa skyabs med pa dpag tu med pa ma lus pa yongs su skyob pa'i mtshan nyid can/zhes pa nas/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis smos serdzo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don gcig med par thal/rgyu phun sum tshogs padang po zhes pa'idang salang med/snying rje chen pos rang rgyud ldan gyi dngor ba'i sems can skyabs med pa dpag med skyob tshul yang med/ tshigs bcad rtsa'agrel gyis nyan rang thub dbang las dang shub dbang byang sems las dang byang sems rnams 'dir bstan chos gsum las zhakhrungs par ma bstan pa'i phyid dang 4 grub ste/ de byang sems kyi thog ma'am sngon du 'gro rgyu la mi byed pa'i pyida'ader bstan snying rje lade 'dra gcig med pa'i pyidade byang sems kyi rgyud kyi deyin pa'i phyig rtagasadangos/ gnyis pa grub ste/des skyob rgyu'i skyabs med pa de la lam ma zhugs gcig med pa'i pyigader thal/dedang lhan cig 'jug pa'i gnyis med kyi blo rang gi grogs su byas pa'i snying rje rgyud la skyes nas skyob rgyu'i skyabs med pa dang gshor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i lam ma zhugs gcig med pa'i sgyigader thal/ gnyis med skya blo rgyud ldan la byang 'phags kyis khyab pa'i pyid rtags 〈snang] khyab lte/ byang sems 'phags pa la skyabs med pa dang gshor ba'i btson rar bsnams pa mi rung ba'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'phags pas na 49
sems bskyed dang po/)( spya gh+nā ṇ+ṭhī] de/'a sprad ba/r+nghi sdir+sha ༵༷ t+pū spridzo )pa/ nyo/gh+nā rnyi r+shar+sha /sdi ༷༷ ( sbyib ༵ r+yaṃ pyi/ /spra ba'i btson rar bsnams pa'i tha snyad kyang mi 'jub pas byang sems tshogs lam chen ponas las nyon gyi dbang du mi 'phro bar mdo du ma las grub pa'i pyid gsum pa ma grub na/ khyod kyis 'dir bstan gnyis med kyi blo dunadam sems bskyed la byed pa 'grel med par thal/ de la byang sems kyi thog mar las rgyu gcig kyang yod pa'i lhag don 'di dag ni rje rin 4 che'i dgongs pa'o/ /ji skad du rnam bshad las/don dam pa'i sems bskyed la 'chad pa ni shin tu ma 'brel te/gnyis su med blo zhes pas thog mar zhugs pa'i byang sems kyi rgyu'i shes rab kyang ston dgos pas 〈sna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig /'jug pa 'dir sangs rgyas byang sems la mchod brjod ma mdzad par snying rje chen 4 kho na la yin te/ rang 'grel las/ sangs rgyas dang zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir zeran/'on/ 'der nyan rang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la'ang don gyis mchod brjod ma mdzad par thal/de dag la lanar mchod brjod gtananas ma byas pa'i pyid rtags khas/ 'dod mi nusate/dedag gi rtsaba'i rgyu la mchod brjod mdzad pa'i phyig rtags sla/ khyab ste/ de ltar mdzad pas de dag don nam rang shugs kyis bsngags par 'gyur ba'i phyirdper na rgyu nor bu la khams che bar bsngags pas rgyu de las grub pa'i sku gzugs sesnags la khams che bar rang shugs kyis bsngags par 'gyo ba bzhin yin pa'i phyis rang 'grel las/ rgyu la mchod par brjod pas kyang 'bras bu la mchod par don gyis 'phangs paradagongs te/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyidrang lugs la/ gdor bstan chos gsum gyingo 4 sogasawenadade/ sbyodon skabs su bshad zin ltarasan pa'i phyid sa mtshamasacanadade/ lam ma zhugasanas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar duphund 50
byang sems kyi rgyu'i gco bo gsum 'chad pa/pa'i pyir te/ 'der bstan snying rje la de ltar yod pa skabs lanar bstan cing snying rje so so'i skabs sems bskyed re bshad pa'i phyir dngan 'dor bstan gnyis med kyi blo la de ltar yod kyang skabs 'der ma bshad pa sa bcu'i skabs su bshad pa la dgongs pa'i pyig dper na sa dang 4 lnga dang phyi ma gsum gyi skabs su yul stong nyid rgyas par bsgoms kyang brjod bde khyad kyis sa drug par rgyas par bshad la gzhan gyi skabs su ma bshad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ bshad tshul 'di snga ma mang pos ma thon kyang / tshigs bcad gong 'og gi rnam bshad dang rang 'grel gyi dgongs pa kho bos bshad pa yin pas blo gsal gzur gnas rnams dga' bar gyis shig /rtsod spong la/ rgyal sras kyi lam la phyogs shes yod pa'i dpyod ldan kha cig na re/ 'dir bstan chos gsum byang sems kyi thog ma'i rgyur bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/de 'dra'i byang sems de'i ma mtha' lam la zhugs ma thag la byed na sems bskyed dang gnyis med kyi blo lda'i rgyur mi rung ba'i skyon yod/ mi byed na gong du zla tshes dang myu gu lta bu'i byang sems su bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyig dang po grub lte/ sems bskyed byang sems kyi sngon du mi 'phyo ba gang zhig/gnyis med kyi blo lade'i phyig sems bskyed rgyud la skye bdang byang sems su gyur pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir te/ khungad 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i nyid gnyis pa grub ste/thog mar sems bskyed nas phyin drug slob skabs gnyis med kyi blo skyed pa yin pa'i pyid zhes pa'i rtsod tshul de/ rnam bshad las/ de ltar na 'di gsum nas/ 'gyur ro zhe na/ zhes byung] de la skyon de med par thal/ 'dir bstan byang sems de tshogs lam thob ma thag nas 'jog kyang skyon de mi 'jug pa'i phyig der thal/ lanar bstan sems bskyed sngon du gso rgyudeyang byang sems kyi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed sgom dus kyi sems bskyed la byed cing / gnyis med kyi blo lda yang don dam sems bskyed ma yin par stong nyid kyi 51
sems bskyedadang po/ltab la byed pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ sngar bkod pa'i skyon ni med de/ nas/ skyon gnyis pa yang med pa ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang rje'i lugs la snang ba'i blun yo mkhas rlom pa kha cig na re/ khyod kyi bshad tshul 'de mi 'thad par thal/ 'di klu sgrub kyi gzhung dang yang 'gal/ byams pa'i gsung dang yang 'gal/ rang gi khas blangs dang yang 'gal ba'i skyon gsumayod pa'i pyid dang sa grub lte/ chosadabyings bstod pa las/ ji ltar tshes pa'i zla ba la/ /skad cig skad cig 'phel bar mthong] /zhes dredags kyis bshad pa'i zla tshes lta bu'i byang sems sadang po bar bshad padang 'gal ba'i pyid gnyis pa grub lte/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar myug sogs rim skyes pas/ /sa bon shun pa gcod pa ltag /zhes byang sems mthong lam pa myu gu ltabu'i byang sems su bshad padang 'gal ba'i pyidagasum pa grub lte/ byams pa'i rnam thar gyi mdo las bshad pa'i rgyal po'i bu skyes ma thag pa lta budang/ mkha' lding gi phrug gu ltabu'i byang sems de tshogs lam pa la byed rigs par thal/ dkon brtsegs dang 'jug 'grel gyi zla tshes ltabudang ldon shing gi myu gu ltabu gnyis tshogs lam pa la byed pa'i mig 'dodan/ khyod rang gis 'grel bshad bkag padang lagal zedalan bzhad gad kyi rgyu khonar snang bas re zhig bzhad gad ṇ+ḍa bya lte/'on/ mdo bstan bcos gangan zla tshes ltabu zhes bshad pa'idonayin na/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/'od srung zla ba tshes pa la zhes sogs kyi zla ba ltabudeyin pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi chosadabyings bstod pa'i don yod pa'i mig gangor gsum/desan zla tshesadakon brtsegs kyis byang chub sems dpa'i dper bkod la chosadapyings bstod pas 'gog bden gyi dper bkod 'dug pa 7do ma mthong ngam kho 'os 43 par 'gyur ro/ /gzhanalang] mdo bstan bcosanas myu gu ltabu zhes bshad pa'i myu gu ltabusanan/ 'jug 'grel gyi sman gyi ldon shing gi myu gu zhes sogs kyi myu gu ltabudesan pas khyab par thal/ rgyud grama'ide'i phyiga'adod na/ ming 52
byang sems kyi rgyu gzhan gnyis kyi yang rtsa bar 'chad pa/gzugs dang mthong lam sogs du ma der 'gyur ba e shes/ rgyud bla ma'ide mthong lam yin gyi byang chub semasadapa' masan pa'i phyir ro/ /desan khyed cagade ltar rtsod cing semasade m+wa 44 nas 'tshang rgya bar 'dodadam/ kwa ye mdzub mo khug cig ces 'doms par byedado/ /gnyis pa byang sems kyi rgyu gzhan gnyis kyi yang rtsabar 'chad pa la/ gang phyir brtsenyid rgyal ba'i lo tog phun tshogs 'di'i/ /sa 'on dang ni 〉la la chu 'dra yun ring pu /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig byung / de mtshams sbyar gyi sgo nas 'chad pag rang 'grel las/ byang chub kyi semasadang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gnyis kyi rtsabayang snying rje yin pa'i phyiran snying rje gtso bo nyid du bstan par 'dod pas zhes byung] de thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ba'i dab gsum 'chad pag rang 'grel las/ ji ltar phyi rol gyi nas/ de bzhin so zhes byung / snying rje kho na yang dus gsum char du de gsum dang 'dra bar 'chad pa la/ snying rje kho na nas/ yin no/ /zhes smyung]thog ma'i snying rje 'chad pas 'di ltar snying rje can nas/ zhes gsungs so/ /zhes byung] bar du gal che ba'i byang sems kyi snying rje 'chad pad byang chub kyi sems bskyed du zin kyang / nas/'gyur ro/ /zhes byung] tha mar gal che ba'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi snying rje 'chad pas 'bras bu mtha' yas pa'i nas/ mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes byung]gdo la sbyi don dngaka mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpal ldan zla bas snying rje la thog mar bstod pa'i rgyu mtshanayod de/ snying rje sngar ltar r+ṇa rang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rtsabasan par ma zad chos phyi ma sems bskyedadang gnyis med kyi slo gnyis kyilang rtsaba'i rgyu'i gtso 'osan pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gnyis kyi rtsaba yang snying rjesan pa'i phyir na snying rje gtso bo nyid du bstan par medod pas gang phyis nas/ zhes 53
sems bskyedadang po/bya ba smos so/ /zhes byung] snying rje chen po de rgyal ba'i 'kha gag phun tshogs skyed pa la rgyu'i gtso 'o yin te/ de de la 'og ma bar ma tha ma'i dus gsum du gal che ba'i pyig dper na me dgag phun tshogs la thog ma'i sa bon dang/ bar gyi chu/ tha mar legs par smin pa gsum gal che ba bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ dpe rigs tha dad pa gsum ltar don yang min te/ dpe gsum las/don snying rjer rigs gcig pa kho na 'chad pa'i ched du nyid sgra smos pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ ji ltar phyi rol gyi 'bru la 〈snags pa phun sum tshogs pa thog ma dang bar dang tha ma rnams su sa 'on dang chudang smin pa rnams gtso bo nyid du gyur pas nye bar mkho ba nyid yin pade bzhin sa snying rje kho na dus gsum char dusang rgyal ba'i lo zugag phun sum tshogs pa la nye bar mkho ba nyid du ston payin zhes dang/ rnam bshad las/nyid kyi sgras ni/ zhes pa nas/ gal che bar bstan rta / /zhes gsungs/snying rje dang 4 gal che ba sa 'on lta bu yin te/ snying rje la brten nas sems can thams cad sdipa ba/shā ༵༵༷ dzāpā k+ṣiṃ kau shā sa kau ༵ /lha ༷ (minā ༷sdu dwo ༷ā pa dī gh+nā 9༷ ༵༵ pa chub la dmigs te sems skyed par byed cing/ de yang gnyis med kyi blo ma 'ob bar de thob par mi nus par shes nas spyod pa pyin drug tshang bar slob pa yin pa'i phyir te/ dper na sa 'on ma btab par myu gu mi 'byung la btab na 'byung ba bzhin snying rje'i sa 'on la byang sems kyi myu gu rag las pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar snying rje can ni gzhan sgya/ zhes pa nas/ nges pa kho nar 'jug lte/zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dis dbang rtul gyi tshos phyi ma gnyis kyi rtsab yin tshul bshad la de ltar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sngar byang sems chos gsum las 'khungs par bshad pa'i skabs sudabang rnon gyi chos gsum bskyed tshul bshad la/ 'der bstan gtso 'olangadabang rnon gyi yinasangan dbang rtul la phan gdags pa'i ched du snying rjedang po'i shugs bstan 'grel pa'i tshig 54
byang sems kyi rgyu gzhan gnyis kyi yang rtsabar 'chad pa/zin la bkod pa yin pa'i phyig de ltar 'grel pas bshad kyang dbang non gyi chos pyi ma gnyis kyi rtsabar 'gyur tshul mi rtogs pa'i skyon med de/ sngar chos gsum las byang sems dbang rnon thog mar zhakhrungs tshul bshad pas 'di'i sems bskyedadang gnyis med kyi blo go bzlogasanas skye bar shugs la go nus pa'i phyig na nus tshul yod de/ theg chen gyi rigs canadabang non lam rdzu r+ṇi sna shā tshi ṭ+wāṃ pyi ñcā lha/ rdzu dī rdo ñcha k+ṣiṃ paX sa snashā /dī pa traṃ dā sdi/ r+shaX dī pa~X rgyas thob par bya zhes thag bcad pa'i tshul gyis sems skyed pa la sangs rgyas thobadagos shingade thob nus par tshad mas ngesadagos/ de la snying rje chen 4 dang lhag bsam rnamadag rgyudang bcas pa legs parares pas sangs rgyas thobadagos par tshad masaresadagos/ sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur bar tshad mas nges pa la stong nyid phu thag chod padangade'i gakhor tha snyad sgyu ma ltabu la dngor 'das 'grog shesadagos pa'i phyig dang 4 grub ste/ rgyud grama'i rnam bshad las/zeg pa chen po'i rigs canadabang po rnon poni thog mar sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob dgos pa dang thob nus pa gnyis tshad mas legs par grub nas/ de'i rjes su sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed pa'i dam bca' lasdog pa yin gyi/ rgyu mtshan yang dag ma mthong bar dam bca' ba dbang 4 rtul bo'i lugs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub lte/ rgyu 'bras mnangag bdun gyi rnam gzhag legs par rtogs na sems can thams cad kyidon du sangs rgyas mi thob pa'i thabs med par rtogs nus pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma'i rnam bshad las/ de yang snying rje chen po lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang bcas ba'i skyed tshul legs par khong du chud pa las ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas 'thob dgos par rtogs la zhes dang / slob springs las/ nye du dngor ba'i r+b+ya mtsho'i khong du chud 55

bstan bcos lus kyi rgyu dang sa'i ngo po mdor bstan pa/mthar son pa'i gang zagasan pa'i pyid gzhan yang skabs 'do'i zag bcas zag med kyidon thun mong ma yin pa gcig med par thal/ mdzod ltar yin pa de'i phyis rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ skabs 'di'i zag pa ma rig pa dang de'i bag chags gang rung la bedzin cing] de gnyis gang rung gis bslad pa zag bcasadang ma bslad pa zag med du lezhug pa'i phyig tshig gsal las/ ma rig pa'i rab rib dang bral bdag gi ye shes zag pa med pa'i yul gyi rang bzhin la ltos nasani ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de skad pu rnam bshad las/ mdzod nas bshad pa ltar gyi zag pa rgyas su mi rung ba la zag med du 'chad pa ni/ lugs 'di'i zag med du langog pa'i don thun mong ma yin pa ma rtogs par snang bas/ zhes pa nas/ yin te/ zhes so/ /yang kho na re/ dag sa'i ma rig bag chags kyi sas kunanas bslangs pa'i zag med kyi las chos can/ zag medasan par thal/ zag med kyi las yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ zag bcas yin pa'i pyidder thal/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyid der thal/ slob pa'i rjes thob kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyig rtags chos can gyis grub/ khyab ste/ sangs ma rgyas tshun chad du 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang rgyun mtha'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed lta bu ma yin pa la ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis ma bslad pa'i shes pa med pa'i phyis der thal/ de tshun chad mnyam rjes res lasdog las dus gcig pa dang ngo 4 gcig pa mi 'ong la/ mnyam lang gi tshe bag chags kyis bslad pa can du skye ba yin pa'i phyisader thal/ rang rgyud pa ltar chos can mthun snang ba med pa'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyis rnam bshad las/ de yang sangs rgyas ma thob tshun chad/nas/ bslad pa can du skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigbyas pa la kho na re/ 'di'i zag pa la ma rig pa 'jog kyang de'i bag chags 'jog pa mi 'thad par thal/ tshigs gsal las kyang ma rig pa'i rab rib dang bral ba tsam las bag chags 95
sems bskyed dang po/ma gsungs la/ rang 'grel las/ ma rig pa'i rab rib kyis gnod pa byas pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyir na ma khyab ste/ zag pa la gnyis yod pas 'di ni nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa slod byed gtso 'o yin pa la/ dgongs tsam dang mtshan gzhi tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ gzhan du na nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa'i zag pa med par thal ba dang] gtsang ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgra bcom gnyis dang byang 'phags kyang yod par thal/ 'di'i zag pa la shes sgrib gcig med pa'i phyir sogs bya la/ rtsabar 'dod na/ dgra bcom gnyis dang dag sa'i byang 'phags rgyud kyi zag bcas ye shes med par thal/ de dag gi rgyud la de slod byed kyi ma rig pa med pa'i phyir/rtags khyab song / rtags grub lte/ sa bdun pa bar du nyon mongs can gyi de yod kyang sa brgyad pa nas spangs par bshad pa'i phyig 'dod na/ skra shad 'dzag snang gi rab rib lta bu'i zag pa de sangs rgyas kho nas spangs la gzhan gyis ma spangs pa'i khyad par mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod pa'i nyid 'dod mi nus te/ rang 'grel las/phung po la sogs padedag nyid ma rig pa'i bag chags dang bral ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis rab rib can ma yin pas/ skra shad mthong ba'i tshul so zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab lte/ lung 'dis ma rig pa'i bag chags rab rib lta bhu dang] de spangs pa'i sangs rgyas rab rib med pa'i gang zag lta bur bshad pa'i phyir/ des na rnam bshad las/ sa bdun pa'i bar du ni ma rig pa'i slod pa yod la/ sa brgyad pa nas dang dgrabacom pa gnyis lani slod byed kyi ma rig pa zadanasades bslad pa med kyi ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis bslad pa ni yod do/ /zhes gsungs/ yang kha cig na re/ zag pa'i sgo drug ce rigs dang 'tshel ba zag bcas dang] de dang bral ba zag med yin te/ kun btus las/ ci'i phyir zag bdang bcas par rnam par bzhag cen/ zag pa yod pa nyidadang] zag pas bcings padang] zag pa dang 'brel ba zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir zega'o na/ dgra bcom gnyis dang dag sa'i byang 96

sems bskyed dang po/de'i tshe yul yul can gyi snang ba nub pa ltar yod kyang nub pa ma yin pa'i pyir te/ nyan sa las/dmigs par bya ba dang dmigs par byed pa mnyam zhing mtshungs pa'i ye shes bzod pa chung ngu dang ldan pade ltabur gyur pa gangasan bdeni dro bar gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /bzod pa 'gring gisaming r+shakā ༵༵ dī shārnyi pa r+yaṃ ༷sdi (snye spra hā ṭ+wāṃ /sna hāX /r+sha/ kau sna ༵༵༵ pa pang(dzo (ji (snropa ༵ 'gag pa ltabur yang snang mod kyide 'gag pa mayinano/ /dmigs pa med pa ltaburalang snang mod kyi de dmigs pa med pa yang masan no/ /de'i sems rab tu zhi zhing med pa ltaburalang snang yod kyi de med pa yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid sgom rim dang yang mthun la/ rgyal tshab rjes kyang 'de la dgongs so/ /yang kha cig na re/ rang 'grel las/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ming can zhes pa'i gnyis med de yul yul can rgyang chad kyi gnyis med la mi byed par mtha' gnyis su med pa la byed par thal/ mtha' gnyis dbu ma pas gtso 'or 'dog pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ mtha' gnyis spangs pa'iwe shes tshogs bh+yor gnyis kyang skabs 'deradangos su bstan par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ yul yul can rgyang chad kyi gnyis snang med pa chu la chu bzhag pa lta bu la byedadagos pa'i phyir te/don dam sems bskyed kyi skabs yin pa'i pyigarnam bshad las/yang 'grel par sa dang po la gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ming can/ zhes gsungs pa ni/ yul yul can rgyang chad du gnyis su snang ba med pa la zer gyi mtha' gnyis spangs pa tsam gyi ye shes la mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ yang tshig gsal dang 'jug pa'i bshad pa byed mkhan 'od kyidamar rtsegs sogs na re/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na dang lhag med du sems dang rig pa kun ldog ste/ ma rig pa dang de'i bag chags zad pa na sems rig kyang ldog pa'i phyir te/ ma rig pa dang de'i bag 98

sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa/dbang du byas par lam rim dang / tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad sogs las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig /byang sems kyi tshul khrims kyi ngo 'o lus ngag tsam gyis spong ba'i lteng nas 'jog par thal/ rang 'grel las/ de yang slong ba bdun gyi mtshan nyid can no zhes dang / tshul khrims le'u las kyang] tshul khrims gsum gyi skabs su lus ngag gi las las ma bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ yid las shugs la go ba'i dbang du byas pa yin pa'i sgyig de ltar ma yin na 'o na/ byang sems kyis lus ngag gi kha na ma 'o ba ma spyad kyang yid tsam gyis gnyung 'byung ba med par thal/ de la nyan thos ltar lus ngag gi sdom pa ma gtogs yid kyi sdom pa med pa'i pyigrtags khas/ 'dod na/ yid tsam gyis byang chub kyi sems btang ba'i rtsasgyung dang / sems can blos spong ba'i ②ltang byung ba'i byang sems re re nas chos can/ khyod la byang sems kyi ②ltang dang de'i tshul 'chal ma byung bar thal/ khyod kyis lus ngag gi galtang ma spyad pa'i phyig rtags khyab khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems la yid kho nas kyang maltang yod la nyan thos la yid kho )pa ṭā ṭ+wāṃ rdzuX/ k+ṣiṃ pa༈ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ pa hānā (((nālha drisra shāspya paX spra h+nā /zer+sha pāpa dīpa/ kyi ni lus dang ngag gi'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems kyi yang ltang bar 'gyur gyi/ nyan thos rnams kyi ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigyang ṭīka byed kha cig/de tshul phun tshogs zhes semags kyis tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang/ yonatanadag pa so sor mi 'chad pa mi lan par thal/ tshul khrims rabasan pas phun sum tshogs padang/ rgyudes sgo gsum gyi spyod padag cing zhi ba dul ba ltabu'iyonatanadag pa so sor bshad dgos pa'i phyir te/ dper na srog mi gcod pa tshul khrims dang/ gzhan la bdeg 'tshog tsamalang mi byed pa slong ba dang po'i yon tan dag pa'i don yin pa'i phyig rang 'grel las kyang/201
sems bskyed gnyis pa/tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa ni tshul khrims rab tu gyur pa'o/ /〈snan tan rnams dag pa nitsangan tan dag pa lte/ zhes sogasadang] sa bcu pa las kyang/ byang chub semasadapa' ni rang bzhin gyis srog gcod pa spangs pasanate/ dbyug pa spangs/ mtshon cha spangs zhes 〈snags gsungs pa'i phyiggnyis pa rang lugs ni/ byang sems kyi tshul khrims la sdom pas ma khyab par ma zad byang sems kyi tshul khrimasadang phar phyin gnyisasan min la mu bzhitsangadade/ de ltar thogs med kyis bshad pa'i pyid byang sems kyi 〈snam pa'i tshul khrims la lus ngag gi las gtso lte/ ②ltang phal cher la de mang ba'i phyig de ltar yin kyang sa bcu pa sogs su mi dge bcu spong bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems la sems tsam gyis kyang gnyung 'byung ba yod pas de 'gog pa'i dbang du byas pa'i pyig der thal/ de 'gog pa'i ched du kun slong tshun chad nas 'gog pa dang byang sems kyis gnod sems ma bkag na byams snying rje byang sems gsum char la gnod pa dang / brnab sems che na bdag bstod gzhan smod sogs 'byung nye ba dang] bdag med phra mo ma bsgoms na dang por ngar 'odzin skye de nas lta ngarna kun skye ba dang / yang dang bor ngar 7rin skye ba sogs chags sdang skye sla ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i nyid rtogs brjod las/ lta ba kun gyi mar gyur pa'i/ /'jig tshogs lta ba skye ba dang] /zhes dngasga rang 'grel las/ de'i phyir kun nas slong bar byed pa dang bcas pa'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas nas las kyi lam bcur rnam par k+ṣiṃ nāX/da/shā padzo pa(sna shāng/zhe]spra dā lhami (lha(shālhar/ r+sha/na/ ༵༵ shāXsna snapa r+sha dzhai ṭ+wāṃ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul khrims dag par mi 'gyur zhing / khyab mtha' ma yin kyang bden par 'dzin na gang zag de'i tshul khrims ngan pa'am 'chal bar byed pas na bden grub tu ltab la gnas mi rigs zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ sa bcu par yang dge mtshan gyi lta ba dang bkra 202
sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa/shes kyi lta ba serdzogs tshul 'chal gyi lta bar gsungs pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ sa bcu pa las/dge mtshan dang bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs dang tshul khrims ngan pa'i lta ba can dang bral ba yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig tshul khrims ngan pa dang tshul 'chal 'gyur khyad yin te/ tshul 'chal gyi skadadod la/ bye brag rtog byed las/ du6gle la zhes gsungs pa dang 'od srung le'u'i 'grel pa'i 'gyur las/'od srung bzhi 4 'di dag ni ngang tshul ngan pa can tshul khrimasadang ldan pa 'dra ba yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid des na de tshul sogs byang 'phags tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas kyang gal te sogs zhar byung du so skye'i rnam grangs kyi tshul 'chal bshad pa yin te/ 'od srung le'u'i don rtsatshig la bkod pa yin pa'i pyid khyab ste/ 'od srung gi le'u'i tshul 'chal gyi gang zag bzhi 4 so skye yin pa'i sgyid der thal/ de bdag bedzin sogs kyis byang sems kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul 'chal la gnas pa brda'i sdom pa can yin pa'i phyir te/'od srung le'u'i 'grel par blo brtan gyis/ brda'i sdom pa la gnas pa gang zhe na/ bzhi po 'di dag tu rig par bya'o/ /de dag kyang bdag tu 'dzin pa la sogs pas rgyun nyams pa'i phyir brda'i sdom pa la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid sa lena'i ming don sogs mdo rgyan rtsa'agrel dngadagongs 'grol dang chos dbyings bstod pa dang / de'i 'grel pa nyan shāka pas legs pa gcig mdzad snang ba 〈snags las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rtsod spong la kho na re/ khyod kyis rje bla ma'i byang chub gzhung lam du byang sems la lus ngag gi bdun gnang ba'i skabasasnund kyi yid kyi gsum ma gnang bar bshad pa mi 'thad par rnyipa/ ༈ shā hā/ rnyi lan+dha r+yaṃ r+shar+sha/lha ༵ pashā r+nghi dī lha gh+nā spriswā dī ba /lha smaṃ ba k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ papa 9 ༵ ༵/ theg bsdus las/ gang byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa de lta bus srog gcod 203
sems bskyed gnyis pa/pa la sogs pa'i las rnam pa bcu spyod gang gis kha na ma 4 bar mi 'gyur la/ bsod nams tshad med pa yang skyed cing / zhes gsungs pa'i pyid khyab ste/ kha na ma 'o bar mi 'gyur la zhes nyes par mi 'gyur bar bshad la/ gnod sems ni rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba che 〈snas gcig yin pa'i phyig 'dir dka' gnas rnams kyi dpyod pa'i sgo nyung gsal byas yod pas blo ldan rnams kyis thugs la bcang bar bya'o/ /smras pa/tshul khrims dag pa'i dkyil gagar yongs su rgyas/ /yon tanadag pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar gyis/ /zhakhrul ba'i mun bsal thub bstan snang ba dang] /phan bde'i ku muta rgyas khyod rgyal sras dpyid/ /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /204
gsum pa 'od byed pa'i sa bshad pa la/ sa'i nges tshig dang / sa'i yon tan dang / mjug sprirmi ṭ+wāṃ rnyipasag//shā n+d+ra hūm̐/ sarnyi swā dz+nyo ༈ r+nghi ny+pha hāX ji rdzu luḍashā kā pa/ hūm̐ hūm̐/la/ /dri](sna pa'i phar phyin ñcha dbye ba dngan sa 'dir 'byung ba'i dag pa'i yon tan gzhan bshad pa bzhi/ dang 4 ni/ gal te gnas min/ zhes sogs byung] gnyis pa ni/ gnod pa byas pa'i zhes sogs rtsa'grel byung] gsum pa ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi zhes serdzogs byung] 'did gang phyir rgyal sras rnams la khros pa yis/ /zhes sogs kyi mtha' dpyad pa la gsum las/ dang 4 la/ kha cig na re/'di'i dngos bstan gyi khro yul la byang sems shig dgos zem kha cig mi dgos zer ba'i phyi ma mi 'thad par thal/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi khro yul la byang sems shig dgos pa'i phyig der thal/'de'i kho yul dang khro ba'i rten gnyis ka byang sems kyi dbang du byas pa gang zhig /de klu sgrub kyi mdo kun btus kyi yang dgongs pa yin pa'i phyig dang po grub ste/ rang 'grel las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid chen po des gang zag gi khyad par du nges pa dang bral ba'i phyir la/nges pa yin du zin kyang nyon mongs goms pa la rag las nas 'jug pa nyid kyi pyir byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rnams la zhes thegags gsungs pa'i phyir khyab ste/ lung 'dis byang sems kyis 'o yul byang sems su mares padang/nges kyang nyon mongs dbang gis byang sems la khros pa'i rgyu bden rdzun gang yin kyang bskal pa brgya'i sbyin padang tshul khrims kyidage rtsa'ajoms par bshad pa'i phyig rnam bshad las/ 'grel par yul rten gnyis ka byang sems kyi dbang du byas par gsungs pani/ zhes serdzo/ /rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ 'jamadapal rnam rol gyi mdo 'dir yul 205
sems bskyed gsum pa/rten gnyis mi gsal yang mdo kun btus su ldon la byams pa seng ge'i sgra'i mdo drangs pa der yul rten gnyis ka byang sems su gsungs pa drangs pa dang] de rjes su dmigs yul med par mdo 'de drangs pa'i shes byed gcig pa la brten pa'i phyig rnam bshad las/ mdo de las khong khro ba'i yul rten gnyis mi gsal yang / zhes pa nas/ yul rten gnyis ka byang sems la gsungs pa de la brten nas mdzad par mngon no/ /zhes so/ /byams pa seng ge'i sgra'i mdo las/ khro ba'i yul rten gnyis ka byang sems yin padang/ dge rtsa'ajums tshul bshad pa yin te/ byang sems kyis stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad la bsdigs brdungs kyang byang sems la rma mi 'byung zhing mi smas la/ byang sems des byang sems gcig la'ang tha na gnod sems tsam gyis kyang rma 'byung ba dang smas par gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ rma byung ba dang smas pa dge rtsabacom pa'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa' gang la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gis byang chub sems dpa' gcig la tha na gnod sems dang/ tha na zhe snang gi sems bskyed pa de tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' la rma 'byung zhing smas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidde la kha cig na re/ 'dir bskal pa brgya'i dge rtsalasdoms tshul bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ slob dpon dpa' bo dang zhi ba lha gnyis das khong khros bskal pa stong gi dge rtsalasdoms par bshad pa'i phyir zer ba la/ kha cig gis skyon de med par thal/ sems can phal pa la khros pas kyang bskal pa stong phrag du ma'i dge rtsalasdoms pa'i phyig der thal/ rgyud 'jug gi rgya 'grel kha cig las gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de ltar bshad pa la shes byed rnam dag med pas yid ches dka' ba'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/'on/ slob dpon dpa' 'odang zhi ba lhas/ zhes pa nas/ yid ches par dka'o/ /zhes so/ /gzhung 'di gnyis kyi khros pas bskal pa brgyadang stong gi 206
sa gsum pa 'od byed pa/dge rtsalasdoms pa la kho yul la sems can phal bas mi lngasnag par thal/de'i yul la byang sems gcig dgos pa'i phyig der thal/ 'jug pa'i bskal pa brgya'i dge rtsalezhums pa ni byang sems che bas byang sems chung ba la khos pa yin pa gang zhig/de'i rigs pas bskal pa stong gidage rtsa'joms pa ni byang sems ma yin pa'i gang zag khyad par bas byang sems la khos par grub pa'i pyid dang po grub lte/ rang 'grel las rten gyi skabs byang sems la bdag nyid chen po'i sgra byung la yul la chen po'i sgra ma byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las/ bskal pa brgya stong du nas/ che ba gcig 'dra'o/ /zhes sesna/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ rnam bshad las/ byang sems ma yin pas byang sems la khros na bskal pa stong du mngon te/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid gzhan yang ṣ+yod 'jug gi rgya 'grel kha cig sems can gang la'ang khros tsam gyis bskal pa stong phrag du ma'i dge rtsa'ajoms par 'dod pa dang / 'jug pa'i don bshad pa'i 'od kha cig gis bskal pa brgya'idage rtsal(mas pa la sems can gang la'ang khos pas chog par gdod pa gnyis la/'o na byang sems kyis sems can phal pa shin tu mang 4 la yid kyis kho ba dang ngag gis gshe ba dang / lus kyis brdeg na byang sems de'i dge rtsal rma 'byung ba dang smas par 'gyur bar thal/de'i yul sems can gang la'ang de 'dra lta ci khros pa tsam gyis bskal pa brgya dang stong gi dge rtsalasdoms pa de'i pyid rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems kyis stong gsum gyi sems can phal pa thams cad la de ltar sgo gsum gyis 'tshe ba byas kyang dge rtsal rma smas mi 'byung la ngan sems kyi grangs ltar bskal par gzhi nas go cha bko mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ byams pa seng ge'i sgra'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' gang la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'dzig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la a+thi+-is pa dang] brgyad pa dang] dbyug pa dang khu tshur gyis brdeg pa de tsam gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' la rma byung zhing rmas par mi 207
sems bskyed gsum pa/'gyur gyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid de skad du rnam bshad las/ stong gsum gyi zhes pa nas/ go cha bgo ba mi dgos par shes so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid 'o na/ de 'dra'i byang sems la nyes pa chen 4 mi 'ong bar thal/ de ltar byas kyang dge rtsam bcom pa'i phyir na shin tu ma khyab pa kho nar shes par bya'o/ /'de la dri ba lhag bsam rabadakar dulangad lta'i sems can khong khro can kun gyi rgyud la sngar yod kyi dge ②kun bcom par smra e nus/ zhes gsungs pa'i skyon sogs kyang 'jug go/gang yang kha cig gis byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo 'di 'dra la zhakhrul nas byang sems kyis byang sems ma yin pa'i sems can gang la yang gshe bdeg /'phrogs kyang byang sems de'i dge rtsagang yang mi 'joms par thal/ mdo de las/ stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad la zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab lte/ de sems can rab byung sogs ma yin pa'i phal pa la dgongs pa'i pyid de ltar ma yinan/'o na/ rgyal sras byang sems kyi sdom ldan gyis nyon mongs drag po'i sgo nas/ dge slong pham pa byung ba khyi ro rul pa lta bu'i lam ma zhugasasan kyang de'i gos 'phrogs pa'am/ lus kyisagazhu brdeg byas sam byed du bcuganade la byang sems kyi rtsaltang 'byung zhingade'i gron byas kyi dge rtsaphal cher 'groms pa mayin par thal/ byang sems kyis gzhan la gnod pa byas pasadage rtsa'ajoms yul la byang sems yan chad gcig dgos pa'i phyig rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/dkon mchog gidakor 'phrogs pa'i gasgyung dang] chos spong ba'i rtsasgyung dang/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i ngur sprig 'phrogs pa sogs kyi rtsasgyungadang/ mtshams med byas pa'i rtsasgyungadang/ midage bcabyed pa'i ②ltang sogs re res kyang dge rtsalasdoms pa'i phyirate/ nam snying gi mdo las/ rtsaba'i lhung ba de dag gis rgyal rigs sbyi 'o nas dbang bskur ba'i dge ba'i rtsab sngon bskyed pa thams cad thal bar brlag lte pham par 'gyur zhing/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de skad du rnam bshad las/208
sa gsum pa 'od byed pa/nam snying gi mdor ②ltang rnams kyis sngon bskyed pa'idage rtsagazhums padang/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig 'dis ②ltang lhag ma skyon du 'phen shes par bya'o/ /go 'o na re/ spyod 'jug gi bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i dge rtsalangoms pa byang sems chung bas che ba la khros par mngon gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ 'o na/ lung bsnyan ma thob pa'i byang sems kyis lung bstan rab pa la lan gcig khros na yang bskal pa stong phrag du ma'i dge rtsalasdoms par thal/ byang sems dma' bas mtho ba tsam la khong kho gcig byas pas bskal pa stong phrag gide bcom pa'i pyid rtags rtsong/ khyab ste/lung bstan thob pa nide bas kyang gnyan pa'i phyig medod mi nus te/ byams pa seṅge'i sgra'i de lung bstan ma thob pas lung bstan thob pa la khros par gsal zhing/de las byang sems la rma smas byung pa'i ngos 'dzin la snang sems kyi grangs ltar bskal par gzhi nas go bgo dgos par bshad pa las shes pa'i phyig der thal/ de bskal ba gcig gi dmyal bar gnas dgos pa dang] bskal pa gcig gi lam la gzhinas go bgodagos pa gnyis las lhag spyod 'jugadang rab zhi rnamanges kyi mdo sogs las mi gsal ba'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ lung bstan thob pa la ma thob pas khros na ni dmyal bar gnas pa bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra la de snyed kyi bskal bar gzhi nas go cha bgo dgos pa dang gnyis yod de/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gzhan yang yul rten gnyis 4 byang sems ma yin kyang khong khos dge rtsalasdoms par ma zad chen po 'joms pa yod par thal/ dge slong gi lus kyis ji tsamanon pa'i rgya khyon gyidapangasadapag tshad brgyad r+ṇi bzhi stong gi rdul grangs kyi lubor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid stong 'gyur gyi bsodanams kyang grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa phan tshun la gnod sems byas na bcom pa rab 'bring tha gsum ci rigs 'byung ba'i phyir te/nye bar lha'or gyis zhus pa las/nye bar dngor tshangs pa mtshungs par bh+yod pa la rma phyung bdang smas bar byas pade ltabungs mthong ste/nye bar gakhoradesadage ba'i rtsab chen 4 7dodag bsrabs 209
